profile: Default optimized cargo bench, isolated target/r03-{baseline,candidate}-build directories.
sampling: 20 flat samples, 300 ms warmup, 2 s measurement target. All runs sequential with taskset -c 2-6 (five physical cores). 3 pairs in baseline/candidate, candidate/baseline, baseline/candidate order.
workload: 16 MiB deterministic incompressible dense source; buffered and O_DIRECT; native q1/64KiB, q8/64KiB, q8/4KiB, q8/1MiB; threaded 4-worker 64KiB controls.
timing: Native copy setup, duplicated endpoint handles, pipeline, explicit cleanup, and destination flush timed. Threaded copy includes its flush. Reset with different payload and flush, full output verification, and FD-count checks excluded each iteration.
resources: GNU time -v measures complete benchmark processes, including setup/verification/Criterion analysis; not per-copy CPU/RSS. Every copy verifies /proc/self/fd count unchanged.
limits: Development laptop, powersave and background processes uncontrolled. Small warm buffered input; direct mode does not imply cold device/controller caches. No sustained-storage claim or per-I/O latency counters.
followup: Investigate +15.25% direct threaded-control movement: repeat direct q8/64KiB and threaded control with identical binaries; 40 flat samples, 500 ms warmup, 4 s target; taskset 2-6; reverse order candidate/baseline, baseline/candidate, candidate/baseline.
validation_only_additions: After measuring, added two public pipeline error/FD-cleanup tests and strengthened the live-ID wraparound unit test. No runtime or harness changes; rebuilding the candidate benchmark reproduced the measured executable SHA-256 exactly.
